snippet.title: KAKU: Ancient Seal | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Fulfill the forgotten prophecy of KAKU: Ancient Seal, now available on PlayStation 5 & Xbox Series!

Enjoy it on:
- PlayStation: https://www.amazon.fr/dp/B0FHPSH8T1
- Xbox: https://www.amazon.fr/dp/B0FHQ94CB7

Explore a vast open world as the young Kaku in this thrilling action RPG. With your trusty companion Piggy by your side, harness the divine power of the Creator Saga to solve puzzles and fight powerful enemies in order to restore balance to the world.

#trailer #launch #xbox #ps5 #adventure #gaming #kaku
